lines.heavy-charged: For a stormy mood, here is weather already tamed. The rain stays off the page, kept back by a crisp white umbrella, offering you a calm place to land.
lines.mid-charged: Restless energy finds an outlet in the bouncing script and zigzag yellow pages, though the poster mostly holds still, a quieter rhythm to steady you.
lines.bright-charged: Its joy is gentler than yours, but it's real: the jaunty umbrella and loose white handwriting carry a wink of humor that keeps your good spirits company.

lines.heavy-calm: When you feel still and inward, these two skiers offer a gentle pull outward, their matched stride climbing a quiet white slope one step at a time.
lines.mid-calm: The pale blue sky and broad white hill keep things unhurried here. The skiers move at an easy, steady pace you could fall into beside them.
lines.bright-calm: Warmth comes through the rust scarves and caps set against all that cool white, a cozy note for a gentle, contented mood.
lines.heavy-mid: On a weighty day, the uphill climb may feel familiar. Yet the two figures lean into it together, poles planted, showing effort can be shared and even enjoyed.
lines.mid-mid: Two figures, one rhythm: their legs and poles echo each other almost exactly, an everyday steadiness turned into a clean, repeating pattern of blue and white.
lines.bright-mid: Hope sits in small things here, like the striped mittens and the white hair flicking back in cold air, the easy pleasures of a good winter outing.
lines.heavy-charged: If a storm is churning inside you, this clear sky and crisp snow give that tension a new direction, turning it into a hard, bright, purposeful climb.
lines.mid-charged: Snow sprays up from every boot, little bursts of white that catch restless energy and give it somewhere to go: forward and up the hill.
lines.bright-charged: Joy lives in that saturated blue and the bold capitals beneath, everything here as brisk and lively as the first good snow of the season.

lines.heavy-calm: If you are feeling low and quiet, this golden yellow ground offers warmth rather than company. The lone orange bloom sits steady on its tuft of leaves, like patient sun.
lines.mid-calm: The flower holds the upper half of the sheet with room to spare, and that open yellow space lets your eye rest before it reaches the lettering below.
lines.bright-calm: Warm yellow, soft orange, a few white flecks at the flower's heart: a gentle brightness that matches your ease without asking you to get up and go.
lines.heavy-mid: For a weighty mood, the deep brown border frames all this gold like a window. The chrysanthemum blooms in autumn, a reminder that color arrives late in the year too.
lines.mid-mid: Kenneth Whitley stacks it neatly: big flower above, sturdy olive green type below. It has the plain, dependable order of a good weekday outing.
lines.bright-mid: The hopeful part is the invitation itself, with the word mum swung out in looping orange script that feels as friendly as a neighbor waving you along.
lines.heavy-charged: If a storm is running through you, those spiky orange petals carry some of that force, but they burst outward into sunny yellow, turning tension into bloom.
lines.mid-charged: Restless energy has somewhere to go here: the petals flare like sparks, and the jagged dark green leaves at the base shoot sideways as if the flower just landed.
lines.bright-charged: Joy is the whole point. One huge chrysanthemum fills the sheet, petals flung wide, and white highlights flicker at its center as if the flower were laughing.
